description: Helmersbuurt 1886-1892 (Bosboom Toussaintstraat 9-27, Tweede Helmersstraat 2-30, Jacob van Lennepkade): 5.4-6.6 m red-brown brick fronts of a ground storey and three tall upper storeys under a frieze and cream cornice at about 14.6 m; three axes of white T-windows under segmental heads with white arch rings and keystones; white sills; wrought-iron balconettes on the centre axis of storeys 1-2; one white pediment dormer over the centre

pediment-dormer.note: Bosboom Toussaintstraat 9-27: one white pediment dormer about 1.4 m wide over the centre, 15.0-16.5 m

door-left.note: house door on the left axis

rhythm.groundFloor: a house door and two windows under arched heads
rhythm.roofline: frieze and cream cornice at 14.6 m, one pediment dormer
schemaLimits: the white arch rings are drawn as keystones only

match.note: Bosboom Toussaintstraat 9-27 (1889): cornice 14.5-14.8 m on the strip; the skyline reads the pediment dormer at 15.5-16.5 m (frontSkylineM)

evidence.citation: strip.jpg at 0.6x with a metre grid: ground to 4.0 m; window rows 4.4-6.6, 7.6-9.4, 10.6-12.4 m; balconettes at 4.6 and 7.8 m; frieze 12.6-13.6 m; cornice to 14.6 m; dormer 15.0-16.5 m
strip.jpg: the same rows under arched white heads, cornice 14.0-14.5 m
